{{Lang|'''Xinyi'''|辛夷}} is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Xinyi is located on the second story of Hongzhen, across from the bridge.

==Profile==
She was once an important figure in [[Jinzhou]]'s [[City Hall]], but has since then resigned and moved to [[Mt. Firmament]] to nurse her illness.<ref>[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — Huanglong: Jinzhou — Hongzhen]]
:''Once an important figure in the City Hall, later resigned to nurse her illness in Mt. Firmament. Now she is in charge of general affairs in Mt. Firmament.''</ref> Succeeding [[Uncle Fu]], she is now the Mayor of [[Hongzhen]], the only settlement in Mt. Firmament, and is in charge of handling Mt. Firmament's affairs.
